hypotheses.reasoning: Redis was restarted after a node replacement with no snapshot, so it came up empty (#1023). The cache miss ratio hit 96% (#1089). Every miss went to postgres, a cache stampede. Postgres hit CPU 96% and nearly all connection slots (#1107), and order queries timed out (#1236). That produced the gateway 504s. The status-poller errors against legacy-inventory started before the incident and are unrelated, so they are a red herring.
Postgres connection and CPU saturation is another possible reading, but it is a symptom of the cache stampede.

verdict.recommendedAction: Warm the redis cache and rate-limit or coalesce cache-miss loads to postgres. Enable redis persistence so a node replacement doesn't start empty. Ignore the legacy-inventory healthcheck noise and remove that deprecated check.
